text:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGE] PagerDuty: PD#98421 triggered — http_inference_gateway error-rate > 7% (5m) in prod-eu-west. Alert details: https://pd.example/incident/98421 :rotating_light:

sam_lee: acked — I'm on it, checking manifests and recent deploys

maya_pat: joining — any customer impact notes yet?

sam_lee: early glance: error spike at 15:02 UTC, ~11k rps, ~900 5xx/min. traces point to edge-proxy -> model-sidecar timeouts (502). Not global, concentrated in eu-west AZs

jordan_r: quick query against ingress logs: `jq '.status|select(.==502)|length' recent_logs.json` shows a sharp jump from ~40 to ~860 in 15:02–15:06 window

sam_lee: deploybot shows a canary deployment of model-serving-v2 started at 14:55 in eu-west. trying to correlate

priya_n: support note: two enterprise customers reporting increased failures in chat completions (AcmeCorp, LumenSoft). Escalated to CSMs, preparing interim status message

diana_support: drafting status page blurb now — waiting for impact confirmation before publish

maya_pat: can we shift traffic away from eu-west to eu-central for affected routes? I can run a temporary routing weight change

sam_lee: doing a conservative shift now, reducing eu-west weight to 0.25 for /v1/generate (routing-api):
```
POST /v1/routing/shift
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "region": "eu-west", "weight": 0.25 }
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by sam_lee at 15:10 UTC

jordan_r: paging history: last 24h no other canaries touched eu-west. logs show increased upstream latency to kv-cache around same time as canary start

sam_lee: starting rollback of model-serving-v2 on eu-west canary set to last-known-good (v1.13). ETA ~3–5m

maya_pat: will monitor client error-rate and tail latencies, also verifying autoscaler activity

diana_support: posted initial status update to status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating elevated 5xx rates in eu-west for generation endpoints; mitigating actions in progress."

priya_n: update from customers: AcmeCorp reduced call volume and sees improvement for some requests after routing changes; LumenSoft still seeing intermittent failures

sam_lee: rollback completed at 15:16 UTC. Observability: 5m error-rate down to ~2.8% (from 7.1%). Tail latencies for /v1/generate back to normal

jordan_r: KV cache team confirms a transient saturation event at 15:03 that amplified errors when the canary increased concurrency; we've opened a follow-up with infra

maya_pat: good — I'll remove the temporary weight tweak once we confirm stability for 15m

sam_lee: marking as mitigated, will escalate to postmortem. opening incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-98421 and adding timeline + commands used

diana_support: publishing consolidated status update now, pinging impacted customers with notes about mitigation and follow-up

priya_n: taking overnight watch handoff — I'll monitor alerts and follow up in the morning with SOC/CSM updates. Maya/jordan will take an action item for infra postmortem

maya_pat: handing off to priya_n — ping me if error-rate creeps above 3.5% again

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident transitioned to "resolved" pending postmortem at 15:40 UTC (automated).

sam_lee: thanks all — filing a short RCA and adding a remediation card to backlog (canary rollback guard + routing safety limits). :thumbsup:

priya_n: acknowledged handoff. I'll post a short interim summary to the channel at 23:00 UTC and update the incident doc if anything else resurfaces.
